opportunities.name: Research a GitHub candidate and email a hiring lead
opportunities.description: For a given GitHub username and role, open the user's GitHub profile, find their top repo and stats (plus their latest blog post), then draft an email to hiring@example.com with subject 'Lead for {role}: {username}' summarizing followers, top repo stars/language, and latest post.
steps: On GitHub, open 'Search or jump to' and type the username, then press Enter
Note follower count, then open the top/pinned repository and note stars and language
Find the person's latest blog post title
In mail, compose a new message to hiring@example.com
Set Body to '{username}: {followers} followers, top repo {repo} ({stars} stars, {language}), latest post: {post_title}.'
Save or send the draft (in the recording it was discarded)

instances.values: karpathy; role ML Research Engineer; top repo nanoGPT
gaearon; role Staff Frontend Engineer; top repo react/react
simonw; role Developer Advocate; top repo llm

opportunities.name: Person profile with archived company homepage note
opportunities.description: For a given person, look up their Wikipedia article (birth date, role), look up their organization's homepage on the Wayback Machine for a given year, and save a summary note.
steps: Search Wikipedia for the person's name and open the article
Note their birth date and current role
On the Wayback Machine, enter the organization's homepage URL and press Enter
Select the target year in the calendar and click a captured date
In notes, create a new note: '{person}: born {date}, {role}. {domain} in {year}: {headline}.'

instances.values: Jacinda Ardern; archive lookup typed but kept failing to load (repeated reloads); no note seen
Tim Berners-Lee; archive page reloaded several times; no note seen
